# Data schema v1

Firestore is the source of truth for settings, bookings, inquiries, customers, members, articles, and AI chats. Google Sheets is not used.

## Export
Owners can download all data as JSON or individual CSV tables from Publication settings. JSON contains schemaVersion, exportedAt, shop (configuration, draft, history), records, and the owner's chats and messages. CSV supports bookings, customers, inquiries, notes, members, posts, services, and staff.

## Files and permissions
Images, attachments, specifications, history, and offline pages remain in the owner's Drive. Exports contain file references but do not embed file bytes, credentials, or other people's private chats. Editing JSON or CSV does not change live data. Cancel bookings and revoke members through the app.
